title: Revisiting Over-refusal in Safety-aligned Large Language Models: A Representation and Optimization Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2610.39802v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Over-refusal is a critical side effect of safety alignment in large language models (LLMs), causing harmless but superficially risky queries to be mistakenly rejected. Despite the effectiveness of existing mitigation methods, why safety-aligned LLMs may still reject harmless queries under correct safety supervision remains insufficiently understood. To address this gap, we analyze over-refusal through the lens of representation and optimization. We make two observations: 1) the representations of harmful and over-refusal samples are visually distinguishable at certain intermediate layers but increasingly overlap in deeper layers; and 2) harmful-sample gradients exhibit high intra-class similarity and concentrate in a low-rank subspace. Moreover, they are more strongly aligned with refusal-target gradients than with correct helpful-target gradients on over-refusal prompts. translated_title: 重新审视安全对齐大语言模型中的过度拒绝问题：表示与优化视角
translated_abstract: 过度拒绝是大语言模型（LLM）安全对齐带来的一个关键副作用，会导致无害但表面上看似有风险的查询被错误地拒绝。尽管现有的缓解方法行之有效，但安全对齐的LLM在正确安全监督下为何仍会拒绝无害查询，目前仍缺乏充分理解。为填补这一空白，我们从表示与优化的角度对过度拒绝进行分析。我们得到两点观察：1）有害样本与过度拒绝样本的表示在某些中间层是视觉上可区分的，但在更深的层中逐渐重叠；2）有害样本的梯度表现出较高的类内相似性，并集中于一个低秩子空间；此外，在过度拒绝提示上，这些梯度与拒绝目标梯度的对齐程度强于与正确有用目标梯度的对齐程度。这种不平衡的梯度耦合会使过度拒绝样本偏向……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本文从表示与优化视角揭示了安全对齐大语言模型过度拒绝的内在机理——有害与无害样本的表示在深层逐渐重叠、有害样本梯度集中于低秩子空间且与拒绝目标梯度存在更强的耦合，从而导致无害查询被误拒。
en_tdlr: This paper explains why safety-aligned LLMs still over-refuse harmless queries from a representation and optimization perspective: the representations of harmful and over-refusal samples increasingly overlap in deeper layers, and harmful-sample gradients concentrated in a low-rank subspace couple more strongly with refusal-target gradients than with helpful-target gradients, biasing the model toward erroneous refusal.
